ranking_note: Real 30-day channel clicks and audience demand lead, then review volume, rating, and deal value. Discovery prioritizes future deadline-verified offers and uses category balancing across practical tech, home, auto, gaming, and personal-care products. Medicines, pharmacy products, vitamins, and dietary supplements are excluded. Products without a verified deadline or with less than 60 minutes left never publish.
